name: Robinson R44
summary: The world's best-selling helicopter: a four-seat piston light helicopter used for training, tours, ranching, news and private flying.

wings: Two-blade teetering main rotor on a tall mast with a small streamlined mast fairing
engines: Piston engine behind the cabin, mostly cowled with side cooling openings
No tall turbine exhaust stack above the engine bay
fuselage: Rounded bubble cabin with two doors on each side (four seats)
Skids on curved struts, or pop-out floats on the Clipper
Small and light, roughly car-sized cabin
tail: Two-blade tail rotor with small upper and lower fins and a horizontal stabilizer

tellTales: Two doors on each side of a small rounded bubble cabin
Thin two-blade rotor on a tall mast with a small mast fairing
Piston engine bay behind the cabin with no turbine exhaust stack

confusedWith.howToTell: The R44 has two doors per side and a cowled engine; the R22 has one door per side and an exposed engine frame.
The R66 has a taller, fully enclosed turbine cowling with an exhaust stack and a baggage door behind the cabin; the R44's piston engine bay is lower and more open.
The JetRanger is larger with a turbine exhaust stack on the roof and a horizontal stabilizer with endplates; the R44 is smaller with a thin tubular boom and tall slender mast.
The Enstrom 280 has a three-blade rotor and three seats under one rounded canopy; the R44 has a two-blade rotor and four seats in two rows.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
